summary: Hain Celestial filed an 8-K reporting that on October 11, 2026 its Board appointed Patricia Ferrari and Richard Shinder as new independent directors, effective immediately. Ferrari joins the Compensation and Strategy Committees; Shinder joins Audit and Strategy. Each receives a $30,000 monthly cash fee under engagement letters, plus the standard indemnification agreement. The filing states no arrangement or understanding with any other person regarding their selection and no Item 404(a) related transactions. This is a board-composition change, not a control event; watch for further board turnover or strategic-review signals given the abrupt, committee-seated additions.
